structure.skip.no-module: Not measured because modules does not include ts
structure.skip.no-typescript: typescript was not found (looked in {from} and the workspace folders). Install it in the project or set checks.structure.typescriptFrom to a folder
structure.skip.no-compiler-api: typescript {version} has no compiler API for building syntax trees. Set checks.structure.typescriptFrom to a folder that has version 5 or 6
structure.bad-pattern: A regular expression in the config is invalid: {patterns}
structure.note.shrunk: {count} cells below the baseline (relock to make the new values the baseline)
structure.finding.fnLines: Function {name} is {value} lines. The limit is {limit}
structure.finding.complexity: Function {name} has cyclomatic complexity {value}. The limit is {limit}
structure.finding.depth: Function {name} nests {value} levels deep. The limit is {limit}
structure.finding.componentHooks: Component {name} calls {value} hooks. The limit is {limit}
structure.finding.emptyCatch: {value} empty catch blocks or .catch() handlers that do nothing. Log the error before moving on
structure.finding.cycles: Value imports form a cycle of {value} files: {name}
structure.finding.paramsOverLimit: {value} functions take more parameters or input fields than the limit
structure.finding.historyComments: {value} comment lines carry history marks (version, PR or ticket numbers). Keep history in git
structure.finding.missingFileHeader: No file header comment. Say what the file does, who calls it and what to read first
structure.finding.routeDb: {value} direct DB calls in a route file. Move them to a service file
structure.finding.routeDbIndirect: {value} DB calls through the app object in a route file. Move them to a service file
structure.finding.serverTop: This file sits at the top level of the server source. Put it under a domain folder
